actions.value:
. /home/probe/session-env; set -eu; date -u +%FT%T.%N; out=/home/probe/evidence/calibration-round2; mkdir -p "$out"; ps -p 34918 -o pid,lstart,args; cat /proc/34918/stat; if timeout 15 /usr/bin/python3 /home/probe/source-input/geometry-oracle/snapshot-guest.py --pid 34918 --backend wayland --require-focused > "$out/editor-focused-oracle.json" 2> "$out/editor-focused-oracle.stderr"; then oracle_rc=0; else oracle_rc=$?; fi; cat "$out/editor-focused-oracle.json" "$out/editor-focused-oracle.stderr"; printf 'EDITOR_ORACLE_EXIT=%s
' "$oracle_rc"; if timeout 25 /usr/bin/python3 /home/probe/source-input/geometry-oracle/atspi-snapshot.py --pid 34918 --max-nodes 200 > "$out/editor-accessibility.jsonl" 2> "$out/editor-accessibility.stderr"; then tree_rc=0; else tree_rc=$?; fi; cat "$out/editor-accessibility.jsonl" "$out/editor-accessibility.stderr"; printf 'EDITOR_TREE_EXIT=%s
' "$tree_rc"; test "$oracle_rc" -eq 0; test "$tree_rc" -eq 0; printf 'ROUND2_EDITOR_PROBE_COMPLETE
'

. /home/probe/session-env; set -eu; root=/home/probe/evidence/source-flatpak; date -u +%FT%T.%N; for f in control-app-manifest.json B-app-manifest.json flathub-sha.txt flathub-submodules.txt A-source-patch.sha256 vala-extension-commit.txt result.txt; do printf 'PROVENANCE_FILE=%s
' "$f"; cat "$root/$f"; done; for case_name in control-stock control-A B-stock B-A; do case_dir="$root/$case_name"; audit="$case_dir/bundle-verification"; printf 'PACKAGE_CASE=%s
' "$case_name"; cat "$audit/result.json"; jq -e '.status == "pass" and .filesVerified == 50' "$audit/result.json"; for f in manifest.yml commit.txt engine-variant.txt bridge-variant.txt completed-at.txt bridge-SHA256SUMS app-SHA256SUMS; do printf 'PACKAGE_FILE=%s/%s
' "$case_name" "$f"; cat "$case_dir/$f"; done; for f in inputs.txt source-all50-SHA256SUMS packaged-all50-SHA256SUMS verified-at.txt; do printf 'AUDIT_FILE=%s/%s
' "$case_name" "$f"; cat "$audit/$f"; done; test "$(wc -l < "$audit/source-all50-SHA256SUMS")" -eq 50; test "$(wc -l < "$audit/packaged-all50-SHA256SUMS")" -eq 50; count=0; for row in "$audit"/[0-9][0-9]; do test -d "$row"; count=$((count + 1)); printf 'FILE_CHECK=%s/%s
' "$case_name" "${row##*/}"; cat "$row/relative-path.txt" "$row/result.txt" "$row/full-hashes.json"; if test -f "$row/allocated-hashes.json"; then cat "$row/allocated-hashes.json"; fi; done; test "$count" -eq 50; cat "$audit/33/source-notes.txt" "$audit/33/packaged-notes.txt"; printf 'PACKAGE_CASE_COMPLETE=%s ROWS=%s
' "$case_name" "$count"; done; printf 'ROUND2_FOUR_PACKAGE_AUDITS_COMPLETE
'

. /home/probe/session-env; set -eu; date -u +%FT%T.%N; gdbus call --session --dest org.gnome.Mutter.DisplayConfig --object-path /org/gnome/Mutter/DisplayConfig --method org.gnome.Mutter.DisplayConfig.GetCurrentState; gsettings list-recursively org.gnome.desktop.a11y.magnifier; gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.a11y.applications screen-magnifier-enabled; gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface toolkit-accessibility; gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.wm.keybindings begin-move; for key in focus-tracking caret-tracking mouse-tracking; do gsettings range org.gnome.desktop.a11y.magnifier "$key"; done; ps -eo pid,lstart,args | grep -E 'atspi-events|dbus-monitor|gdbus monitor|gnome-shell|gnome-text-editor' || :; printf 'ROUND2_SETTINGS_PROBE_COMPLETE\n'
